description: This course introduces computer systems to students from the perspective of a programmer. Students learn about the computer systems, focusing on the hardware and operating systems, and how they impact the design, implementation, and performance of a program. Topics covered include the C language, data representations, machine-level representations of C programmes, memory hierarchy, program optimisation, linking, interrupts and signals, memory management, system-level I/O, and concurrency.
